All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
BusinessException
Common root of every business-rule violation raised by the parking lot domain.
Car
A regular passenger car.
CargoVehicle
A cargo or freight vehicle.
CheckInVehicleUseCase
Checks a vehicle into the parking lot: validates it does not already have an active ticket, finds and occupies a compatible available space, and opens a new ticket for it.
CheckOutVehicleUseCase
Checks a vehicle out of the parking lot: closes its active ticket (which computes the final amount) and releases the space it occupied.
GetOccupancyByTypeUseCase
Computes how many spaces of each type are available, occupied, and out of service.
GetTotalRevenueUseCase
Computes the total revenue collected across every registered payment.
HourlyRate
Base Rate implementation: charges a fixed amount for every billable hour (see TimeUtil.billableHours(long)), with no cap.
IncompatibleSpaceException
Thrown when attempting to assign a space whose SpaceType does not match the vehicle's required type.
InMemoryParkingSpaceRepository
In-memory ParkingSpaceRepository implementation, backed by an ArrayList.
InMemoryParkingTicketRepository
In-memory ParkingTicketRepository implementation, backed by an ArrayList and an internal, monotonically increasing counter for ticket numbers.
InMemoryPaymentRepository
In-memory PaymentRepository implementation, backed by an ArrayList and an internal, monotonically increasing counter for payment identifiers.
InMemoryVehicleRepository
In-memory VehicleRepository implementation, backed by an ArrayList.
ListActiveTicketsUseCase
Lists every currently active ticket.
ListAvailableSpacesUseCase
Lists every currently available space of a given type.
ListVehiclesInsideUseCase
Lists every vehicle that is currently inside the parking lot, i.e.
Main
Quick console demonstration of the full check-in -> check-out -> payment flow, driven entirely through the use cases exposed by ParkingSystem.
Motorcycle
A motorcycle.
NoAvailableSpaceException
Thrown when there is no available, compatible space to assign to an entering vehicle.
ParkingSpace
A physical space in the parking lot.
ParkingSpaceRepository
Persistence port for ParkingSpace instances.
ParkingSystem
Composition root of the application.
ParkingTests
Simple test harness (no external dependencies) covering the 15 mandatory cases from section 12 of the assignment, exercised strictly through the ParkingSystem use cases rather than by poking at repositories or entities directly - the same way any real delivery mechanism (a CLI, a REST controller) would use the application.
ParkingTicket
Represents one vehicle's stay in the parking lot, from entry to closing.
ParkingTicketRepository
Persistence port for ParkingTicket instances, including the generation of unique ticket numbers.
Payment
An immutable record of a payment made against an already-closed ParkingTicket.
PaymentRepository
Persistence port for Payment instances, including the generation of unique payment identifiers.
PaymentType
Payment methods accepted when settling a ParkingTicket.
Rate
Fee-calculation strategy (Strategy pattern).
RateWithDailyCap
Rate decorator (Decorator pattern) that applies a maximum amount per 24-hour period once the stay reaches a configured minimum number of hours.
RegisterParkingSpaceUseCase
Registers a new physical space in the parking lot.
RegisterPaymentUseCase
Registers the payment for a closed ticket and marks the ticket as paid.
RegisterVehicleUseCase
Registers a new vehicle in the system so it becomes eligible to check in.
SpaceNotAvailableException
Root exception for the cases where one specific, already-identified space cannot be assigned to a vehicle.
SpaceOccupiedException
Thrown when attempting to assign a space that is already OCCUPIED by another vehicle.
SpaceOutOfServiceException
Thrown when attempting to assign a space that is marked OUT_OF_SERVICE.
SpaceStatus
Lifecycle states of a ParkingSpace.
SpaceType
Enumerates the kinds of parking space that the lot can offer.
TicketNotActiveException
Thrown when attempting to register an exit for a vehicle that has no currently active ticket.
TicketStatus
Lifecycle states of a ParkingTicket.
TicketStillActiveException
Thrown when attempting to pay a ticket that has not been closed yet (business rule: "an active ticket cannot be paid").
TimeUtil
Stateless time-calculation helpers shared by the rate classes.
ValidateSpaceAssignmentUseCase
Validates, in isolation, whether one specific space could be assigned to one specific vehicle.
Vehicle
Common abstraction for every vehicle that can enter the parking lot.
VehicleRepository
Persistence port for Vehicle instances.
VehicleWithActiveTicketException
Thrown when a vehicle attempts to check in while it already has an ACTIVE ticket open (assignment rule: "a vehicle cannot have two active tickets").
